inputs.name: Ferrero-Washington mu=0 for abelian number fields
inputs.statement: For every prime l and every finite abelian F/Q, the unramified Iwasawa module of its cyclotomic Z_l-extension has mu=0.

sources.title: The Iwasawa invariant mu_p vanishes for abelian number fields
sources.publisher_path_note: The publisher's live path says 190-2 but its page explicitly identifies Volume 109. The chapter uses the stable DOI.

inputs.qualification: The stated theorem is for every prime, including 2. The later odd-prime restriction on minus-part consequences is not imported into this theorem. TW1 proves the exact finite-layer rank proposition used by Lean.

inputs.name: Ordinary Iwasawa module and algebraic structure theorem
inputs.statement: The norm inverse limit of l-primary class groups in a Z_l-extension is finitely generated torsion over Z_l[[Gamma]], and identifies with the maximal unramified abelian pro-l Galois group. Its structure theorem has finite errors and distinguished-polynomial/l-power factors.
inputs.qualification: TW1 derives Z_l-finite generation from mu=0 and proves the finite-layer norm-surjectivity step. No unspecified finite-layer control theorem is retained.

inputs.name: Finite Hilbert class-field reciprocity with norm compatibility
inputs.statement: For a totally complex number field, the maximal everywhere-unramified abelian extension has Galois group its ideal class group. Artin restriction agrees with ideal norm.

sources.author: J. S. Milne
sources.title: Class Field Theory
sources.location: Chapter V, Theorem 3.6, Corollary 3.7 and Example 3.9, pp. 158–159

inputs.qualification: All fields in the FW application contain nonreal roots of unity, so no narrow-class or real-place correction is hidden at l=2. Norm compatibility is also explained using Frobenius.

inputs.name: Abelian conductor-discriminant formula
inputs.statement: The absolute discriminant of an abelian field is the product of the conductors of its characters; a subfield of Q(zeta_N) of degree n therefore has |Delta|<=N^n.
inputs.qualification: The same classical leaf is already used as part of OB-MD. Root-degree, conductor enlargement, all uniform constants and model transfer are proved in TW6.
